svg.title: The Haat loop, from voice note to every maker paid
svg.desc: Ten steps light up in order: voice note, listing, PayPal catalog, buyer agent, human approval in PayPal, capture, export paperwork, tracking, makers paid, maker told in Hindi. The recorded run took 55 seconds.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE LOOP · ONE SANDBOX RUN, VOICE NOTE TO MAKERS’ SPLIT
